notes: Returns `arg1 < 0`, i.e. the standard Win32 HRESULT FAILED() check (negative HRESULT = failure). Called ~20 times across jagdx/IDirect3D.kt, IDirect3DDevice.kt, IDirect3DSwapChain.kt as `if (ue.a(97.toByte(), hresultValue)) throw fda(hresultValue.toString())`. The Byte arg0 is always passed as the literal constant `97.toByte()` ('a') at every call site and is never used in the method body -- a classic obfuscator decoy/opaque-predicate parameter, not a real input.

Returns `arg0 >= 0`, i.e. the HRESULT SUCCEEDED() check. Only one call site found (IDirect3DDevice.kt:9: `if (ue.a(this._CreateEventQuery(local5), false)) return local5 else return null`), where the boolean arg1 is always passed as the literal `false` and never used in the method body -- another decoy/opaque-predicate parameter mirroring the Byte decoy in the other overload.
